title: ROUND ( 2.15, 1 ) is 2.2

source.quote: The following formula rounds 2.15 up, to one decimal place. The expected result is 2.2.
source.supports: the example gives the result 2.2; Return value: a decimal number

notes: 2.15 has no exact binary representation (it is slightly below 2.15), so an engine that rounds the binary value gives 2.1. The documentation says 2.2.
